About ICEI

Six decades of sheet-metal Engineering

1964

Foundation

The first plant was established by Mr. Abd EL Moniem as a workshop in Cairo, for the purpose of manufacturing spare parts for the Egyptian Railways.

1972

Entering the Automotive Sector

ICEI began supplying the automotive sector, starting with NASCO.

1985

Growth & Specialization

The start of a close collaboration with General Motors (GME) — work that shaped ICEI into a specialist in sheet-metal working and chassis-commodity feeding for the automotive industry.

Equipment & Tooling Capability

Built for high-precision sheet metal

  • Hydraulic presses up to 1000 tons
  • Mechanical presses up to 800 tons
  • Shear presses up to 16 mm thickness
  • CNC Punch Presses
  • Tooling & Dies Workshop — CNC milling machines, wire-cut machines
  • CAD/CAM system
  • Spot Welding Line
  • Welding Laboratory
  • CMM (Coordinate Measuring Machine)
  • ED Painting Line

Tooling Capability

CONTROL-VEMA Joint Venture

An Egyptian–Italian joint-venture agreement established in 2009 for tooling fabrication, dies manufacturing, dies design and assembly of fixtures for ICEI.

Developed SIDE MEMBER piercing dies for VL01, replacing an AMADA punching machine — solving quality issues related to hole shifting.
